items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: Because they had this fellow, Wesley Dine from Baton Rouge, he was dead. He was playing trumpet. Most of all the fellas were playing around here.

ctx.x: Who did he play with him?

I don't know. I don't remember Dave Ogden being with the Maple Leaf Band. I wanted to ask about if you noticed any difference in the bands uptown and the ones downtown. Like Bob Lyons, did they play a different type of music or a different beat or anything in your Maple Leaf? Same type. No, same type. Because they had this fellow, Wesley Dine from Baton Rouge, he was dead. He was playing trumpet. Most of all the fellas were playing around here. And they all were playing about this thing. They weren't any rougher…
